brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: 3 half-n pieces stacked vertically at 0,0,0 / 0,0,1 / 0,0,2 (piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:0,0,1;half-n, piece:0,0,2;half-n)
drawer:0#0,0#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#0,0#cut at level 1 fitted to the cut faces of the half bases

requirements.requirement: one of them shown pulled open
requirements.evidence: setDrawerOpen true on drawer at 0,0,0 level 0; other drawer remains closed

finish.summary: Built a 3-high vertical stack of half-n bases forming a cabinet. Added two slide drawers to the cut faces at levels 0 and 1, with the lower drawer set to open and the upper closed. check_build passes meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
